name: Fat Ladybug 84
author: AqFox
description: Neon gradient 3d sky-blue button that reacts on hover.
howItWorks: Its CSS has no :hover rule that changes a visible property; hovering it shows no change.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Fat Ladybug 84</title>
<style>
/* Fat Ladybug 84 by AqFox — https://uiverse.io/AqFox/fat-ladybug-84 */
button {
  --c: #fff;

  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0000 33%, #fff5, #0000 67%) var(--_p,100%)/300% no-repeat,
    #004dff;

  color: #0000;
  border: none;
  transform: perspective(500px) rotateY(calc(20deg*var(--_i,-1)));
  text-shadow: calc(var(--_i,-1)* 0.08em) -.01em 0   var(--c),
    calc(var(--_i,-1)*-0.08em)  .01em 2px #0004;
  outline-offset: .1em;
  transition: 0.3s;
}

button:hover,
button:focus-visible {
  --_p: 0%;
  --_i: 1;
}

button:active {
  text-shadow: none;
  color: var(--c);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 9e9q #0005;
  transition: 0s;
}

button {
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 2rem;
  margin: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: .1em .3em;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>BUTTON</button>

</body>
</html>
